unit_rules.name: Author of the Shattered Scriptures
unit_rules.text:
At the start of the Battle Round, do one of the following:
* Add 1 to the OC of friendly units within 6"
* Target an enemy unit within 24" with the "Second Vow" stretegem for 0CP.
* Target a friendly unit within 12" with a Strategem for 0 CP

unit_rules.name: Bodyguards of the Regent
unit_rules.text: While within 3" of a friendly +Shattered Legions Infantry+ unit, this model has +Lone Operative+.
